nodes.summary: Run bun test with the JUnit reporter and print the receipt document; refuses an unqualified bun version or lockfile
usage: corvint-js-test-provider bun [--dir DIR] [--bun FILE] [--package-json FILE] [--lockfile FILE] [--runner-version VERSION] [--max-concurrency N] [--test-name-pattern PATTERN] [--timeout DURATION] [--test-file FILE]... [--env-key KEY]... [--preload FILE]... [--service NAME]... [--retain]

nodes.summary: Run the bound Playwright adapter and print the receipt document; with --external-server the canonical qualified receipt
usage: corvint-js-test-provider e2e [--dir DIR] [--config FILE] [--package-json FILE] [--lockfile FILE] [--runner-version VERSION] [--app-build-dir DIR] [--external-server] [--app-identity ID] [--app-attestation-command FILE] [--app-attestation-config FILE] [--app-attestation-timeout DURATION] [--sensitive-input-redaction] [--sensitive-action-pattern PATTERN]... [--sensitive-field NAME]... [--retain-attempt-details] [--keep-reporters] [--keep-reporters-qualification FILE] [--server-ready-url URL] [--server-ready-timeout DURATION] [--preflight FILE] [--server-arg ARG]... [--test-arg ARG]... [--test-file FILE]... [--env-key KEY]... [--timeout DURATION] [--runner-output PATH] [--interrupt-grace DURATION] [--retain] [--watch RELPATH... --foreground --experimental --trusted-local]

nodes.summary: Print the external-origin dependence report from a project policy and network evidence of 1..16 runs; runs no test
Generate step-level negative controls for one Playwright test
usage: corvint-js-test-provider negate --root DIR --spec FILE --test TITLE [--project NAME] [--step N | --all-steps] [--max-runs N] [--baseline-repeat N] [--dir DIR] [--config FILE] [--package-json FILE] [--lockfile FILE] [--runner-version VERSION] [--app-build-dir DIR] [--external-server] [--app-identity ID] [--app-attestation-command FILE] [--app-attestation-config FILE] [--app-attestation-timeout DURATION] [--server-ready-url URL] [--server-ready-timeout DURATION] [--timeout DURATION] [--test-file FILE]... [--env-key KEY]...
